title: Forensic Expert Registration
description: Complete registration form for forensic experts joining the ICJ empanelled panel.

steps.stepDescription: Your forensic specialisation, certifying body, and experience.

fields.name: forensic_specialization
fields.label: Forensic Specialisation
fields.helpText: Select the primary area of forensic science in which you specialise.

fields.name: certifying_body
fields.label: Certifying Body / Board
fields.placeholder: e.g., American Board of Forensic Document Examiners
fields.helpText: Name of the professional body or board that has certified your forensic expertise (optional).

fields.name: experience_years
fields.label: Years of Experience
fields.helpText: Total years of professional forensic experience.

steps.stepDescription: Your academic qualifications in forensic science or a related field.

fields.name: university
fields.label: University / Institution
fields.helpText: Name of the university or institution that awarded your degree.

fields.name: passing_year
fields.label: Year of Passing
fields.helpText: Year in which you passed your highest degree.

steps.stepDescription: Your experience as an expert witness in court proceedings.

fields.name: court_testimony
fields.label: Have you testified as an expert witness?
fields.helpText: Indicate whether you have previously appeared as an expert witness in any court or tribunal.

fields.name: testimony_count
fields.label: Approximate number of testimonies
fields.helpText: Approximate total number of times you have testified as an expert witness.

fields.name: courts_appeared
fields.label: Courts Appeared In
fields.helpText: Select all courts or tribunals where you have appeared as an expert witness (optional).

steps.stepDescription: Upload required documents to verify your credentials.

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Passport-size Photograph
fields.helpText: Upload a recent passport-size photograph (JPG or PNG, max 2 MB).

fields.name: professional_certificate
fields.label: Primary Professional Certificate
fields.helpText: Upload your primary forensic/professional certificate (PDF or JPG, max 5 MB).

fields.name: identity_proof
fields.label: Identity Proof
fields.helpText: Upload a government-issued identity document (PDF, JPG or PNG, max 5 MB).
